---
title: "MAGiC Uncertainty"
---

This site reports the sensitivity and uncertainty analyses of the SIPNET ecosystem model
used in the MAGiC inventory runs for California cropland.

- [Local Sensitivity](analysis/local_sensitivity.qmd) ranks the model parameters by their
  contribution to the variance of modeled soil carbon and nitrous oxide flux at 100 design
  points, and methane at 11 design points with recorded rice seasons.
- [Global Sensitivity](analysis/global_sensitivity.qmd) partitions the modeled soil-carbon
  and nitrous-oxide output variance among parameters, initial conditions, meteorology,
  and management at 10 design points.

The [training](docs/training/index.qmd) pages show how to run both analyses on the
inputs of an ensemble run.
